meaning.en: Likely to be a hindrance; disadvantageous.
meaning.vi: Có thể là một trở ngại; bất lợi.
Có hoặc thể hiện sự chống đối; bất lợi.

meaning.en: Not favorable.  Not propitious. Adverse, contrary, or disadvantageous.
meaning.vi: Không thuận lợi. Không tham vọng. Bất lợi, trái ngược, hoặc bất lợi.

meaning.en: Disadvantageous, adverse, unsuitable, inconducive; serving to hinder or oppose.
meaning.vi: Bất lợi, bất lợi, không phù hợp, không thích hợp; phục vụ để cản trở hoặc chống đối.

meaning.en: (of a belief, state of mind, etc) Not favorable, disapproving.
meaning.vi: (của một niềm tin, trạng thái của tâm trí, v.v.) Không thuận lợi, không tán thành.

meaning.en: (of wind or weather) Causing obstacles or delay; not conducive to travel or work; inclement.
meaning.vi: (gió hoặc thời tiết) Gây trở ngại hoặc chậm trễ; không có lợi cho việc đi du lịch hoặc làm việc; sự khó chịu.

sentences.en: They also enter diapause at unfavorable times of the year.
sentences.vi: Họ cũng nhập cuộc vào những thời điểm không thuận lợi trong năm.

sentences.en: Their unfavorable reports intensified the worsening situation and finally compelled Percival to surrender.

sentences.en: There are no complications per se from the tests themselves with the exception of unfavorable test results or supine (lying horizontality on the back) hypotension secondary to a pregnant woman lying on her back for an ultrasound.

sentences.en: The study hypothesizes that women who have a history of intrauterine device expulsion are likely to have "unfavorable uterine conditions," which may include poor positioning, small size, and subtle malformation.

sentences.en: Much of it has to do with your shape; if you are more square, you will have more padding around the sides of the stomach, and a string bikini might create an unfavorable, stocky silhouette.

sentences.en: This means that contractions are started with an unfavorable cervix, often with the membranes still intact.

sentences.en: In people without an HLA-identical sibling but with an alternative donor, this type of transplant was rated appropriate in those with unfavorable cytogenetics.
